verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss is a CRM, so a visual deal pipeline is a fair question. The evidence pack never documents a visual pipeline, customizable deal stages, or drag-and-drop updates. The only related items are adjacent: a passing reference to a person 'stage' (Trash) in the API, Smart Lists, and custom fields such as customClosePrice. None of these establishes the capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track deals on a visual pipeline with customizable stages and drag-and-drop updates
